purpose: Install three new read-only test-only window hooks (__notestrTestGroupEpoch, __notestrTestGroupMembers, __notestrTestPubkeyLeafCount) inside the existing gated useEffect in src/marmot/client.tsx, declare them in the ambient Window type, and expose thin page.evaluate wrappers in the e2e fixtures layer.

public_api.name: __notestrTestGroupEpoch
public_api.description: Returns Number(g.state.groupContext.epoch) for the group with the given idStr, or null if absent. bigint coerced via Number() to cross the Playwright serialization boundary.

public_api.name: __notestrTestGroupMembers
public_api.description: Returns getGroupMembers(g.state) as a sorted array of hex strings, or null if no group with that idStr is loaded.

public_api.name: __notestrTestPubkeyLeafCount
public_api.description: Returns getPubkeyLeafNodes(g.state, pubkeyHex).length. Returns 0 for unknown pubkeys or absent groups.

public_api.name: getGroupEpochHook
public_api.description: e2e/fixtures/two-party.ts wrapper: calls __notestrTestGroupEpoch via page.evaluate. Throws if hook not installed.

public_api.name: getGroupMembersHook
public_api.description: e2e/fixtures/two-party.ts wrapper: calls __notestrTestGroupMembers via page.evaluate. Throws if hook not installed.

public_api.name: getPubkeyLeafCountHook
public_api.signature: (page: Page, groupIdStr: string, pubkeyHex: string) => Promise<number>
public_api.description: e2e/fixtures/two-party.ts wrapper: calls __notestrTestPubkeyLeafCount via page.evaluate. Throws if hook not installed.

dependencies_forbidden: e2e/ (no compile-time import from src/ to e2e/)
external_ports: window.__notestrTestGroupEpoch (runtime bridge only, no compile-time coupling)
